column1: Impact and timeline: statement, sequence, missed signals [SO3]
column6: States what happened, when, and who or what was affected; sequences events, decisions, and signals with the times the record has; names at least one missed signal or says there was none.
column12: Two or more of the three missing.

column1: Root cause analysis: systemic, past first answers [SO6]
column2: reaches systemic causes, not first answers or scapegoats
column6: Analysis reaches systemic causes past the first answer (five-whys or contributing-factors style), and includes what made detection slow, if it was.
column9: Analysis goes one level deep but stops early, misses contributing factors, or does not examine detection.
column12: Analysis stops at the first answer or lands on a scapegoat.

column2: systems language, co-signable by everyone involved
column6: Systems language throughout; the unit of analysis is the process, not the person; every person involved could happily co-sign the document.
column9: Mostly blameless, with occasional slips into person-focused framing.
column12: Blames individuals, or is written so that people involved could not co-sign it.

column1: Corrective actions: specific, owned, dated, verifiable [SO2]
column2: specific, owned, dated, and at least one verifiable at the week-10 checkpoint or sprint note
column6: 3 to 5 specific changes, each with an owner and a date, distinguishing "prevent recurrence" from "detect faster"; at least one is verifiable at the week-10 repo checkpoint or in the week-10 sprint note. AI involvement in the incident or recovery is addressed plainly if applicable.
column9: Actions are listed but some lack owners or dates, the prevent/detect distinction is missing, or none is verifiable at the week-10 checkpoint or sprint note.
column12: Actions are missing, generic ("be more careful"), or unowned.

column1: Writing: length, sections, causes tied to events [SO3]
column6: 2 to 3 pages in docs/postmortems/; the required sections present and in order; every stated cause or fix is tied to an event in the timeline.
column12: Two or more of the three missing.
